image_style: Simple hand-drawn stick figure cartoon, like the attached sample (stickman-style.png). Black ink lines only, one even line weight. Round head with a simple face (dot eyes, a big readable expression), single-line arms and legs; a plain shirt or tie shape only when the story needs it. Props are simple black outline doodles. Plain warm off-white paper background with a faint paper texture; a place is shown with a few simple outline lines only when the line needs one. No shading, no gradients, no colour, no realistic detail, no words or letters (simple symbols like $ are fine), no watermark, no frame. Vertical 9:16, subject centred with room above and below for captions.
